description: Intentional changes to frozen first-party UI files. Each entry records the original hash, the reviewed hash, why it changed, and which tests cover the behavior.

assets.reason: sendMessage, runAssistantTurn and driveAssistantSse split into named functions of 60 lines or fewer, with awaits kept at the same points so sends and turns start in the same tick as before. A finished failed reply refreshes its Retry action. A rejected unlock passphrase is selected so typing again replaces it. Live thinking text skips the Markdown cache. The clock is sent on the newest user message instead of a leading system message, so the cached prompt prefix survives between turns; replies save cached token counts. Uses the safe default when assembling assistant-turn approval settings. Refreshes process discovery when the agent starts a terminal call.

A failed last reply gets a visible Retry action that re-sends the user's message through the existing unchanged-edit path. Rendered Markdown is cached (bounded, never for streaming text, cleared on lock) so reopening a long chat does not parse every reply again. A code block that is still streaming gets its frame and background (highlighting still waits for the closing fence). Turn usage stats add up cached prompt tokens. Refreshes the process monitor on chat changes and clears it for an empty draft.
Stream start and end refresh Retry actions, so Retry hides while a turn runs. Displays and saves the safe default while preserving all three approval modes.

When the chat column is narrow (sidebar and Activity open), the composer uses the existing compact Branch button and keeps its tools on one row instead of stacking them; the empty capabilities label stays on one line. On touch screens the capability chip remove button gets a larger invisible tap area that does not cover the label. Prompt reuse is grouped under the context details with an aligned percentage and subtle divider, removing the standalone cache label from the composer toolbar.
verifiedBy: Visual check at 1024px with sidebar and Activity open, idle and streaming

assets.reason: Style for the always-visible Retry action on a failed reply, matching the other message actions. On touch screens the code copy button gets a larger invisible tap area.
verifiedBy: Visual check of a failed reply

assets.reason: Locking encrypted data also clears the rendered-Markdown cache, which holds decrypted chat text. Adds explicit auto_all approval mode and defaults new or unset preferences to auto_safe while preserving saved choices. Clears process logs, pending requests and stop controls when local data locks.

Groups prompt-cache reuse and token counts inside the context tooltip, removing the standalone toolbar label. Adds explicit approve-all with a warning icon and accessible danger tooltip, selects safe auto-approval by default, and explains approval behavior for enabled tools. Adds the expandable per-chat Processes dock with a static terminal icon.

Shows provider-reported prompt reuse for the running turn or latest reply in a dedicated context-tooltip section with token counts; hides the section when cache data is unavailable. Uses the safe default when assembling turn approval settings.

The welcome screen shows model setup only after provider discovery finishes with no selectable models. It reads the server catalog directly so an unpopulated picker cannot flash setup for configured users.
Styles the approve-all warning icon and responsive tooltip shown on hover or focus; constrains the approval control to its settings column so choices wrap on narrow screens.
Forwards all three approval modes to Loop turns and uses the safe default when unset.
Refreshes the independent process monitor when terminal tool results arrive.
